title: Weekly BIM coordination of a federated cloud project: collect, check, correct, report, archive
intent: Keep a federated cloud project current in one weekly session: collect model data in an unattended batch, check it against fixed rules and last week's snapshot, repair what is safe to repair, queue the rest for approval, and report a dashboard with week-over-week trends.

sequence.do: Preflight: application idle, bridge alive, disk and cloud cache space, registry compared with the cloud folder (new or renamed models), no model open
Collect in batch (unattended): per-model health export, link and workset report, schedule exports, family size report; raw outputs to REPORTS/<date>
Collect deep, read-only: warnings by type, link status and transform, ProjectPosition against the authority, Project Information keys, element counts; open each model with all worksets closed
Check: one dataset keyed by model and week, compared with last week, against the rule table

Correct: safe fixes automatically (repair links to the matrix, missing building name, missing standard schedules, sync); anything that moves geometry, changes coordinates or deletes waits for the coordinator's approval
Report: dashboard pages (project health, federation, model quality, data quality) and a one-page summary
Archive: append the week to history tables; never edit raw outputs; submit new lessons to the inbox

rule_table.rule: Every host has each link its matrix defines, none missing or duplicated
Every link instance placed by shared coordinates; when all models share one coordinate system and one internal origin, the link transform is identity
Shared origin and angle equal the authority model, tolerance 0.01 ft
Building name equals the registry key; no template placeholder text
Count up more than 10% week over week, or a new warning type
Over 300 MB or up more than 15% in a week
Any family over 5 MB; in-place count rising
Required fields filled in at least 95% of instances per category
Sheet numbers unique; sheets without views flagged
Links on their own link worksets; elements on the default workset below a set limit
Standard schedules and view templates present
Every model in the cloud folder has a registry row, and the reverse

data_model: Star schema keyed by ModelKey and SnapshotDate: Models and Snapshots (dimensions); ModelHealth, Warnings, Links (host x link), ParameterFill (model x category x parameter), Families, Findings (model x rule) as facts. Raw outputs per run in REPORTS/<date>; history appended per table in HISTORY.
decisions_for_the_user: Required parameters per category for the fill-rate check
Dashboard delivery (in-session dashboard or an external BI tool)
Approval of every geometry, coordinate, workset or delete fix
discipline_authority: Discipline leads: content of their models; the routine reports, it does not redesign

results_recorded.note: Designed from one day of federation work; not yet run end to end. Measured parts: 156 links in 21 min; standard schedules for 5 models in about 2.5 min; batch opens 7-11 s per model.
